points.title: 童年与青年时期
points.description: 希特勒于1889年4月20日出生于奥地利布劳瑙的一家小客栈。他的父亲是海关官员，母亲是农家女。1903年父亲去世后，希特勒与母亲和妹妹生活在一起。希特勒在学校表现平平，对权威充满反抗，对艺术表现出浓厚兴趣。1907年，他前往维也纳，希望能进入艺术学院学习绘画，但两次申请均被拒绝。这段时期他接触了泛日耳曼民族主义思想，形成了强烈的反犹和反马克思主义观念。
points.descriptionEn: Hitler was born on April 20, 1889, in Braunau am Inn, Austria, in a small inn. His father was a customs official and his mother was a peasant woman. After his father's death in 1903, Hitler lived with his mother and sister. He performed poorly in school, showing rebellious behavior toward authority and a strong interest in art. In 1907, he moved to Vienna hoping to study painting at the Academy of Fine Arts, but was rejected twice. During this period, he was exposed to Pan-German nationalist ideas and developed strong anti-Semitic and anti-Marxist views.

points.title: 维也纳岁月
points.description: 在维也纳的五年间，希特勒过着贫困潦倒的生活，依靠打零工和继承母亲的微薄遗产度日。他大量阅读政治和哲学著作，深受德国民族主义作家和反犹思想家如休斯顿·斯图尔特·张伯伦的影响。这段时期他形成了极端的民族主义、反犹主义和反民主思想，认为民主制度软弱无力，只有强权政治才能拯救德国。维也纳的经历塑造了他后来的政治理念，成为他日后纳粹意识形态的重要基础。
points.descriptionEn: During his five years in Vienna, Hitler lived in poverty, working odd jobs and relying on his mother's small inheritance. He extensively read political and philosophical works, deeply influenced by German nationalist writers and anti-Semitic thinkers like Houston Stewart Chamberlain. This period shaped his extreme nationalist, anti-Semitic, and anti-democratic ideas, believing that democracy was weak and only authoritarian politics could save Germany. His Vienna experiences formed the ideological foundation for his later Nazi beliefs.

points.title: 一战军旅生涯
points.description: 1914年，希特勒移居德国慕尼黑，并在第一次世界大战爆发后立即志愿加入巴伐利亚陆军。他在西线服役，担任传令兵，经历了索姆河战役等重大战斗，两次获得铁十字勋章。战争的经历强化了他的极端民族主义思想，使他深信德国的失败是由于国内叛徒（主要是犹太人和马克思主义者）的背叛，而非军事上的失败。1918年德国战败后，希特勒极度震惊，决心投身政治，阻止类似悲剧重演。
points.descriptionEn: In 1914, Hitler moved to Munich, Germany, and immediately volunteered for the Bavarian Army at the outbreak of World War I. He served on the Western Front as a messenger, experiencing major battles like the Battle of the Somme, and was awarded the Iron Cross twice. The war experience reinforced his extreme nationalism, leading him to believe Germany's defeat was due to betrayal by internal traitors (mainly Jews and Marxists) rather than military defeat. After Germany's defeat in 1918, Hitler was deeply shocked and determined to enter politics to prevent similar tragedies.

points.title: 政治崛起
points.description: 战后，希特勒留在慕尼黑，加入德国工人党（后更名为纳粹党）。凭借其出色的演讲才能和煽动性，他迅速成为党的核心人物。1921年，他成为纳粹党领袖，确立了党内独裁地位。1923年11月8日，希特勒在慕尼黑啤酒馆发动政变，试图推翻巴伐利亚政府，建立全国性政权，但失败被捕。在审判期间，他利用法庭宣传自己的政治理念，扩大了知名度。这次失败的经历使他认识到，必须通过合法途径夺取权力，而非暴力政变。
points.descriptionEn: After the war, Hitler remained in Munich and joined the German Workers' Party (later renamed the Nazi Party). With his exceptional oratory skills and demagoguery, he quickly became the party's central figure. In 1921, he became the leader of the Nazi Party, establishing dictatorial control within the party. On November 8, 1923, Hitler launched the Beer Hall Putsch in Munich, attempting to overthrow the Bavarian government and establish a national regime, but failed and was arrested. During his trial, he used the court to publicize his political ideas, increasing his notoriety. This failure taught him the need to seize power through legal means rather than violent coups.

points.title: 纳粹德国领袖
points.description: 1933年1月30日，希特勒被任命为德国总理，开始建立独裁统治。1934年，在兴登堡总统去世后，他集总统和总理权力于一身，成为元首(Führer)。在柏林，希特勒实施了多项政策：废除民主制度、建立集中营、推行种族主义政策、重整军备、实施五年计划经济政策。1939年，他下令入侵波兰，引发第二次世界大战。战争期间，他领导德国及其盟国与同盟国作战，并实施了针对犹太人和其他少数群体的种族灭绝政策。1945年4月30日，在苏联军队逼近柏林时，希特勒在总理府地堡自杀身亡。
points.descriptionEn: On January 30, 1933, Hitler was appointed German Chancellor and began establishing a dictatorship. In 1934, following President Hindenburg's death, he combined the powers of president and chancellor, becoming Führer. In Berlin, Hitler implemented numerous policies: abolishing democracy, establishing concentration camps, implementing racist policies, rearming Germany, and introducing the Four-Year Plan economic policies. In 1939, he ordered the invasion of Poland, triggering World War II. During the war, he led Germany and its allies against the Allied powers and implemented the Holocaust against Jews and other minorities. On April 30, 1945, as Soviet troops approached Berlin, Hitler committed suicide in the Reich Chancellery bunker.

points.title: 东线战争
points.description: 1941年6月22日，希特勒发动对苏联的巴巴罗萨行动，开启了东线战争。这一决策成为他军事生涯的最大转折点。在东线，德军初期取得重大胜利，但未能迅速击败苏联。随着战争的持续，德军陷入消耗战，在斯大林格勒战役(1942-1943)和库尔斯克会战(1943)中遭受惨重损失。希特勒坚持不退让的战略决策，拒绝承认失败，导致德军遭受更大伤亡。东线战争消耗了德国大量军事资源，成为纳粹德国最终失败的关键因素之一。希特勒对东线战场的直接指挥，体现了其军事决策的固执与风险。
points.descriptionEn: On June 22, 1941, Hitler launched Operation Barbarossa, the invasion of the Soviet Union, opening the Eastern Front. This decision became the major turning point in his military career. On the Eastern Front, German forces achieved significant initial victories but failed to quickly defeat the Soviet Union. As the war continued, the Germans became bogged down in a war of attrition, suffering heavy losses at the Battle of Stalingrad (1942-1943) and the Battle of Kursk (191943). Hitler's insistence on not retreating and refusing to admit defeat led to even greater German casualties. The Eastern Front consumed enormous German military resources and became one of the key factors in Nazi Germany's eventual defeat. Hitler's direct command of the Eastern Front demonstrated the stubbornness and riskiness of his military decisions.

supporter.zh: 在极少数极端民族主义者和新纳粹团体中，希特勒被视为民族复兴的伟大领袖。支持者认为他结束了德国的魏玛共和国混乱时期，恢复了国家尊严和经济繁荣，重建了军事力量，并挑战了国际秩序。他们赞扬他的领导才能和演讲技巧，认为他代表了德意志民族的意志，为德国摆脱一战后的屈辱地位做出了贡献。然而，这种观点完全忽视了纳粹政权对内残暴统治、对外发动侵略战争以及实施种族灭绝的严重罪行。
supporter.en: In a small number of extreme nationalist and neo-Nazi groups, Hitler is viewed as a great leader of national revival. Supporters believe he ended the chaotic period of Germany's Weimar Republic, restored national dignity and economic prosperity, rebuilt military strength, and challenged the international order. They praise his leadership skills and oratory abilities, seeing him as representing the will of the German people and contributing to Germany's摆脱 post-WWI humiliation. However, this perspective completely ignores the brutal domestic rule, aggressive wars, and genocide committed by the Nazi regime.

critic.zh: 绝大多数历史学家和普通民众将希特勒视为历史上最残暴的独裁者之一。批评者指出，他建立了极权主义统治，摧毁了德国民主制度，建立了恐怖警察国家，实施了种族灭绝政策，导致约6000万人死亡的世界大战。他的反犹主义意识形态导致了大屠杀这一人类历史上最严重的罪行之一。希特勒的决策充满了军事冒险主义，如过早对美宣战、两线作战等，最终导致德国的彻底毁灭。他的统治给德国和世界带来了深重灾难，其历史评价几乎完全是负面的。
critic.en: The vast majority of historians and ordinary people view Hitler as one of the most brutal dictators in history. Critics point out that he established a totalitarian regime, destroyed Germany's democratic system, created a terror police state, implemented genocidal policies, and led to a world war that caused approximately 60 million deaths. His anti-Semitic ideology led to the Holocaust, one of the worst crimes in human history. Hitler's decisions were filled with military adventurism, such as declaring war on the US too early and fighting on two fronts, ultimately leading to Germany's complete destruction. His rule brought profound disaster to Germany and the world, and his historical evaluation is almost entirely negative.

objective.zh: 从客观历史视角看，希特勒是20世纪最具影响力的政治人物之一，也是研究极权主义、种族主义和民族主义极端化的典型案例。历史学界普遍认为，希特勒的崛起反映了魏玛共和国的民主失败、经济危机和社会动荡。他的统治展示了独裁者如何利用经济困难、民族情绪和宣传机器获取并维持权力。在流行文化中，希特勒常被用作邪恶和暴政的象征，成为各种艺术作品和流行文化中的反面教材。他的生平也成为研究独裁心理学、群众动员技术和极权主义运作机制的重要案例。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Hitler is one of the most influential political figures of the 20th century and a typical case study for studying totalitarianism, racism, and extreme nationalism. Historiography generally agrees that Hitler's rise reflected the democratic failure of the Weimar Republic, economic crises, and social turmoil. His rule demonstrates how dictators can use economic difficulties, national sentiment, and propaganda machinery to acquire and maintain power. In popular culture, Hitler often serves as a symbol of evil and tyranny, becoming a反面教材 in various artistic works and popular culture. His life has also become an important case study for studying dictatorial psychology, mass mobilization techniques, and the mechanisms of totalitarianism.

self.zh: 凡是要大成就的人，必须奋斗，而奋斗就要有牺牲。
self.en: Anyone who wants to achieve great things must struggle, and struggle requires sacrifice.

others.zh: 希特勒是历史上最邪恶的人物之一，他的意识形态和行为导致了人类历史上最黑暗的篇章。
others.en: Hitler is one of the most evil figures in history, his ideology and actions led to the darkest chapter in human history.
